report.candidate_letter:
Dear candidate,

Thank you for your application for the ML Engineer position. We regret to inform you that your application is not moving forward. This is because your CV does not show the following required experiences:
- 3+ years of ML in production (training, testing, deployment, monitoring of real-time models)
- Proven experience with modern deep learning techniques and Gradient Boosting Trees
- Excellent Python coding skills
- Proficiency with ML libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, LightGBM, and Scikit-learn
- Experience with microservices architecture, cloud technologies, Docker, and Kubernetes

This decision was prepared with an automated system. You have the right to request a human review of this decision (GDPR Art. 22): simply reply to this message.

Kind regards
